# Seven

The cellar was cold in a way the house never was.{++ It held the cold the
way a stone holds it, grudgingly and for a long time.++}

He set the lamp on the {~~table~>barrel head~~} and waited for his eyes.
{--There was nothing down there but wine and the smell of wine.--}

{==Somebody had been down here since the rain.==}{>>too on-the-nose; let
the footprints do the work<<}
